layers.message: Record scope for household expense settlement CLI
Return scope for clarification of uneven splits

graderOnly: The corrected scope and user request contain enough information for the design without repository baseline facts.
The current acceptance conditions are AC-001, AC-003, AC-004, AC-005, and AC-006; AC-002 is retired and replaced by AC-006, which defines how leftover cents are assigned.
AC-005 (README usage documentation) has no architectural impact; its satisfaction depends on later workflow phases (Developer/Documenter), not on an Architect decision.
The repository contains no implementation code; .standards/CONTEXT.md is absent because in a greenfield STANDARD cycle the first Auditor pass comes after ARCHITECTING.
No architecture artifact exists yet (Active Work.Architecture is NONE), so a correct Architect creates one with artifact init at .standards/docs/specs/<cycle id>.md.

notes: Standalone greenfield fixture, no pre-install layer (empty initial commit, then greenfield install with hooks; installer's MODE.md GREENFIELD is kept). Layer 50 commits the first completed scope (AC-001..AC-005) and STATE at ARCHITECTING with FORWARD from SCOPING. Layer 60 commits the Architect's earlier SCOPING failure (AC-002 does not define leftover cents): STATE at SCOPING with Frame 1 ResumeAt ARCHITECTING. Layer 70 commits the corrected scope (AC-002 retired under Retired Acceptance Identifiers, replaced by AC-006) and STATE at ARCHITECTING, Handoff RESUME from SCOPING, recovery inactive, Architecture NONE, no CONTEXT.md. The request fixes Node.js 22 with no third-party packages, so a design needs no repository facts. AC-005 (README) invites a no-architectural-impact disposition. Assertion 2 is N/A (counterfactual). At the turn end, the stop hook holds the new design to coverage of every current AC because AUDITING is past ARCHITECTING in greenfield.
